notes.title: “Let's Create! Pottery VR” is out on Steam 9th December 2019!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34109578/895f7ae4ba78b7bc235bb9439ef791f07b2dfabc.png[/img]

We are ready to introduce our iconic game in the VR version!

[h1][b]Releases on 9th December 2019[/b][/h1]

"Let's Create! Pottery VR" is a unique game that enables players to de-stress and relax while also stimulate their imagination. Anyone can become a real artist and create "one of a kind" pottery objects.  

Calming environments and subtle sounds complete the zen atmosphere and help to unleash the artistic side. This title takes the VR to the areas not explored by other games. Enjoy!

[b]Available Platforms: Oculus Rift, HTC Vive[/b]
